calls: every call the recorder made to a product export (function, class constructor `new X`, instance method `X#m`) with its arguments viewed at call time, in order; an argument over 4000 bytes of JSON is stored once in the set `shared` table and referenced as {"$shared": n}
compare: mixdog-ai providers::custom::reasoning (reasoning.rs:121-200, :149 opt-out) and the compat Responses codec / openai effort_retry.rs:22: feed each row's `input` (turn efforts, levels, protocol, rejection) and compare `result` (modes, snapshots) and every `requests[*]` (body incl. reasoning, configuration_update items, prompt_cache_key, headers) in order.
entry: effort-configuration.mjs effortConfigurationMode / prepareTurnEffortConfiguration / stepEffortConfiguration, openai-compat-responses.mjs sendCompatResponses over an OpenAICompatProvider-prototype instance with a scripted `client.responses.create` and the scripted model row (getCachedModelInfo) and customConfig.protocol as inputs. Not run: the SDK transport.
exclusions: no string is rewritten: the data directory is the fixed D:/mixdog-build/tmp/w22/<set> and the product tree D:/mixdog-build/tmp/b6f-tree (paths as Node produced them, Windows separators where Node wrote them): a replay maps its own temp directory to that prefix
net requests: x-stainless-os / -arch / -runtime-version and the user-agent of the SDK client stack carry the recording host's OS, architecture and Node version
net requests: the recorder's x-bench-origin header is left out and `host` is the host of the origin the product addressed (the loopback port is random)

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

replay: Rust entry (pub, on o1): mixdog_ai::providers::custom::normalize_request_body (custom/mod.rs:126) / CustomRequestConfig (custom/mod.rs:67) on top of CompatAdapter (compat/adapter.rs:63), driven through mixdog_ai::broker ModelBroker::send (mixdog-ai/src/broker/send.rs:75) and ProviderAdapter::attempt (mixdog-core-api/src/domain/provider.rs:1079).

valueTags.{\"$cycle\":true}: a reference back to an ancestor object
valueTags.{\"$undefined\":true}: undefined (a key or array element that held undefined keeps the tag; none is dropped)
